changelog: Initial release: laptop and placeable desktop PC running ACN OS (terminal, mail and contracts, files, profile, manual, settings).
Procedural white-hat missions in four categories (network, defense, crypto, forensics) with a mandatory tutorial, hints, two terminal mini-games, XP ranks, challenges and achievements.
Computer shop NPC and full in-game configuration with /conf_acn_security (raycast placement, prices, settings, placed PCs, logs and Discord webhook).
